summary: JPMorgan Emerging Markets Dividend Income plc is a closed-ended equity mutual fund launched and managed by JPMorgan Funds Limited. It is co-managed by JPMorgan Asset Management (UK) Limited. The fund invests in the public equity markets of emerging market countries across the globe. It seeks to invest in stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. The fund invests in stocks of companies across all market capitalizations. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the MSCI Emerging Markets Index. JPMorgan Emerging Markets Dividend Income plc was formed on July 29, 2010 and is domiciled in the United Kingdom.
summary_fr: JPMorgan Emerging Markets Dividend Income plc est un fonds commun de placement d'actions à capital fixe lancé et géré par JPMorgan Funds Limited. Il est co-géré par JPMorgan Asset Management (UK) Limited. Le fonds investit sur les marchés boursiers publics des pays émergents du monde entier. Il cherche à investir dans des actions de sociétés opérant dans des secteurs diversifiés. Le fonds investit dans des actions de sociétés de toutes capitalisations boursières. Il compare la performance de son portefeuille à l'indice MSCI Emerging Markets. JPMorgan Emerging Markets Dividend Income plc a été créée le 29 juillet 2010 et est domiciliée au Royaume-Uni.
